facts.fact: The Ghana Hubs Network statement refers to the National AI Strategy (2025-2035) as the strategy whose implementation the President has committed funds to.
The Ghana Hubs Network says the President has committed US$20 million to the short- to medium-term implementation of the National AI Strategy (2025-2035).

The Ghana Hubs Network says Cabinet has approved US$250 million for a national AI computing centre, and that the Communications Minister said Phase One is due within 24 months with procurement under way at the Public Procurement Authority.

GHA.note: The document states no data centre for hire in service; the national AI computing centre is planned.
No nationally owned data centre for hire in service is stated; the planned AI computing centre is not in service.
The network asks for consultation on the AI computing centre; it does not state that the government consulted anyone.
No startup law, label or fund is stated; startup access to the planned centre is only requested.
The document names no hub, programme, city or park in service.
